realReviews.author: Minerva Simpson
realReviews.text: I hired them 2 years ago to replace a front stoop/small porch. I was so happy with them and the work that I hired them to replace a back deck, which was a larger job. Once again, very happy. If a deck can be beautiful, it is. The work is meticulous with attention to detail. The owner, Will, communicates and cares about the work he does. I plan to hire them for another deck section that needs replacing.

realReviews.author: Deborah Newlin
realReviews.text: A1, indeed! We'd called several companies for a demo and complete rebuild of a 20ft high 22×8 deck using composite decking.  Mr. Will's estimate was by far the most reasonable. He and his crew estimated 1 week, and they were right on target. The team took time clean up the area, even using devices to find dropped screws in the grass. The deck and stairs are beautifully done, and we couldn't be happier! We've already talked to them about coming back next summer for work on our back deck. HIGHLY recommend you call A1.

realReviews.author: Keith Powell
realReviews.text: We needed a 20 year old 4 ft wooden fence replaced. They gave us the best quote and said they’d have us scheduled within 2 weeks. Just a few days later they called to say they had time the next day to get our job done while they waited on supplies for another job. When we came home the job was complete perfection. Such quality work!   I won’t ever call anyone else for fence work!

finalCta.headline: Ready for a new deck or fence?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos and rough measurements or pick a time for a site visit. You'll get a written estimate before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a fair price and a straight answer.

faq.q: Should I go with composite or wood?
faq.a: It depends on your budget and how much upkeep you want. Composite needs less maintenance; wood costs less up front. We'll walk you through both at the site visit.

faq.q: What kinds of fences do you install?
faq.a: Wood, picket and chain link fences, new or as a full replacement of an old fence.

faq.q: Do you repair docks and seawalls?
faq.a: Yes. Dock and seawall repair is part of the work, along with deck and stair repairs.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set up a site visit.
